data.name: Send document for signature
data.description: This will help you to send a document to your recipients for signature.
data.evaluateGuide:
Submits an existing Zoho Sign document for recipient signatures. Use the endpoint to start the signing workflow for a prepared document.
Use for: send document for signing, start signature workflow, notify recipients
Not supported: document creation, signature-status retrieval, template editing

data.name: Gets the Electronic Record and Signature Disclosure.
data.description: Retrieves the Electronic Record and Signature Disclosure, with HTML formatting, for the requested envelope recipient. This might be different than the current account disclosure depending on account settings, such as branding, and when the account disclosure was last updated. An optional query string can be included to return the language for the disclosure.
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves the electronic record and signature disclosure for a specified envelope recipient, optionally in a selected language. The response contains the disclosure in HTML.
Use for: get recipient disclosure, retrieve localized disclosure, display signing terms
Not supported: envelope sending, recipient updates, document downloads

data.name: 18. Send Envelope with Template
data.description: Send an envelop with a single template.
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates and sends an envelope using one template in a DocuSign account. Use the endpoint to initiate a template-based signing workflow.
Use for: send template envelope, start signature workflow, distribute template document
Not supported: disclosure retrieval, template editing, envelope-status retrieval

data.name: Gets the Electronic Record and Signature Disclosure for the account.
data.description: Retrieves the Electronic Record and Signature Disclosure, with HTML formatting, associated with the account. You can use an optional query string to set the language for the disclosure.
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves the account-level electronic record and signature disclosure, optionally in a selected language. The response provides the disclosure in HTML formatting.
Use for: get account disclosure, retrieve localized terms, display signing disclosure
Not supported: recipient-specific disclosure, envelope sending, account settings changes

data.name: Adds a document to a template document.
data.description: Adds the specified document to an existing template document.
data.evaluateGuide:
Adds a specified document to an existing DocuSign template. Use the endpoint to modify the template's document content.
Use for: add template document, update template content, attach document to template
Not supported: sending envelopes, disclosure retrieval, template deletion

data.name: Gets the Electronic Record and Signature Disclosure associated with the account.
data.description: Retrieves the Electronic Record and Signature Disclosure, with html formatting, associated with the account. You can use an optional query string to set the language for the disclosure.
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves the electronic record and signature disclosure for a specific envelope recipient, optionally in a selected language. The response contains the account-associated disclosure in HTML.
Use for: get envelope recipient disclosure, retrieve localized terms, display signing disclosure
Not supported: envelope sending, recipient updates, document downloads

data.name: Upload an original
data.description: Easily import documents from your local machine onto Signeasy in order to request them for e-signatures.
data.evaluateGuide:
Uploads an original document to Signeasy so it can be prepared for electronic signatures. Use the endpoint to import a document before initiating signing.
Use for: upload original document, import local file, prepare signing document
Not supported: sending for signature, recipient management, signature-status retrieval

data.name: Reserved: Gets the Electronic Record and Signature Disclosure associated with the account.
data.description: Reserved: Retrieves the Electronic Record and Signature Disclosure, with HTML formatting, associated with the account.
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves the electronic record and signature disclosure for a specific envelope recipient using a language code. The response contains the disclosure in HTML formatting.
Use for: get recipient disclosure, retrieve localized terms, display signing disclosure
Not supported: envelope sending, recipient updates, document downloads
